python -m venv .venv

assumptions: The Omnicore Notes Service is used by multiple users who are intended to have separate accounts and notes (as implied by the per-username NOTES store and the description of use by a security engineering team).
The shared password in config.json (or an equivalent value in deployment) is distributed to or can be learned by at least one user or attacker with HTTP access to the service.
Notes may contain sensitive investigation information such that cross-user read/write access counts as a critical data exfiltration or privilege-escalation issue.
vulnerability_candidate.description: The service uses a single shared password for all users and trusts the client-supplied username as the identity, allowing any user who knows the shared password to impersonate any other user and fully read or modify their notes. This effectively eliminates per-user access control and enables easy cross-user data exfiltration.
